words.sourceMeaning: 시도, 노력 ('입찰'이라는 뜻도 있으며, in a bid to는 '~하기 위한 시도로')

meanings.en: An attempt to achieve or obtain something.
meanings.wrongEn: A refusal to take any action at all.

words.sourceMeaning: 효용 (경제학에서 어떤 선택으로 얻는 만족의 정도. '유용성, 공공 설비'라는 뜻도 있음)

meanings.en: In economics, the satisfaction or benefit a person gets from a choice.
meanings.wrongEn: The cost of transporting goods by ship.

words.sourceMeaning: 만족하는 (be content to는 '기꺼이 ~하다, ~에 만족하다'. 명사 '내용'과 강세 위치가 다름)

meanings.en: Happy and satisfied with what one has.
meanings.wrongEn: Angry and ready to argue with others.

words.sourceMeaning: 연속적인, 순차적인 (결정이 한 번에 끝나지 않고 차례로 이어진다는 뜻)

meanings.en: Following one after another in a fixed order.
meanings.wrongEn: Happening all at the same moment.

words.sourceMeaning: 만약 ~라면 (If the initial minimum requirements should prove too ambitious에서 If를 생략하고 Should를 앞으로 보낸 가정법 도치)

meanings.en: A structure in which "should" is placed before the subject to mean "if" something happens.
meanings.wrongEn: A structure used to give a direct order to someone.
